description: Adam's personal skill collection including animation adapters, video composition, CLI tools, and search utilities.

interface.shortDescription: Teaching content skills: turn a lesson into a click-driven web presentation.
interface.longDescription: Adam's personal skill collection. Currently ships /edu-web-powerpoint, which turns a lesson PDF/Word document or a key-points outline into a click-driven 16:9 web presentation (web-ppt) with companion hands-on exercise folders. Skills are selected by their SKILL.md description.
defaultPrompt: Turn this lesson PDF into a classroom web presentation.
I have key points and an outline, make a web-ppt from it.
